Title: NETMESSAGE:Erm... I'm no archeologist, but that stuff isn't ancient!
Translation: 呃……我不是考古学家，但那东西不是古代的！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Hey! What the hell is going on?!!
NETMESSAGE:Hey, it's some sort of camp, what the hell happened here?
Translation: 嘿，是个营地，这里发生了什么？

Title: NETMESSAGE:It seems the archeologists had an armed escort.\nBut why? Did they know about this place?
Translation: 看来考古学家有武装护卫。\n但为什么？他们知道这个地方吗？

Title: NETMESSAGE:Let's open up these crates and see what we can use. \n God knows what we're up against...
Translation: 打开这些箱子看看我们能用到什么。 \n天知道我们要面对什么……

Title: NETMESSAGE:Holy shit! What the hell are those?!
Translation: 天哪！那些是什么鬼东西？！

Title: NETMESSAGE:There it is again! What the hell is it?!
Translation: 又是它！那到底是什么玩意儿？！

Title: NETMESSAGE:I think I saw another one!
NETMESSAGE:Hey! Did you see something move?\nWhat was it?
Translation: 嘿！你看到有什么东西在动吗？\n那是什么？
